title: 第十章 故人哀（男主上线）
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

大黄狗的嘴继续动，传递着云百里的声音：“勉大将军，云某也识得几个字，花上有个‘芳’字，想来是你义母给你的吧？孝敬孟婆姐姐的两朵，不好讨回。薅下去换续魂丹的这朵，云某想明白后，实在觉得拿着烫手，还是给你送过来。”

“你人还怪好的唻。”秦勉从狗嘴里取出金花。

自然是湿漉漉的，沾满黄狗的口水。

云百里怕她嫌恶心又不好意思有所动作，主动提议：“都是这孬狗的涎，你赶紧擦擦。”

秦勉掏出帕子擦拭，一面问道：“你来阳间，可待多久？”

“今日亥时，就得回地府去。我可没说是给你送东西的。我与城隍讲的是，来与你再作一番宣谕，莫孟浪行事，若因还魂查案而改了太多人的命数，只怕后土娘娘问罪地府，不再给咱们进人作鬼差的员额。”

秦勉听完，低低地“唔”一声。

云百里听出她的隐约失望，点破道：“你是不是以为，我既然可以寄魂猫狗，便也可以附在什么小厮丫鬟的身上，去到暗算你们的人家，获知他们的言行？”

秦勉颔首：“方才乍见你，我的确闪过念头。但听你所言，想来神鬼帝后，严禁你们介入人间因果，只作死后赏善罚恶之举，自对鬼差严加管束，我不能害你违令。好比落魂于金家铺子，我也得处处留心，不能为了查明真相，连累金家老少。”

云百里摇着尾巴，盯着沙土上斑驳的树影，静静地听。

孟婆姐姐请他喝酒时，常与他唠叨，女人最擅长的手腕，就是装作体恤、可怜、无助，同时摆出坚持道义的强调，一副宁可人负我、不可我负人的假面孔。

如此，女人便能将男子那番挺身而出的英雄气勾出来，骗他们做马前卒甚至替罪羊。

孟婆的话，云百里能听进几句，但对秦勉，他纵然没打多久交道，仍相信这姑娘，不是在造作地欲擒故纵。

秦勉可以不要将来那许多次的轮回重生，只要自己寻到的真相，能给恩人一个交代，又怎会是刁滑自私、玩弄人心的鼠辈呢？

云百里想帮她，尽力帮她。

即使他与她，都是蝼蚁。

云百里于是狗姿蹲坐，以一半宽慰、一半征询的语气，对秦勉道：“要不，我今日离魂后，你带这只黄狗回金宅养着？我后头，设法再与城隍或阎君请奏，哪怕偶尔能附魂黄狗，或许亦可助你一臂之力。”

秦勉不欣然接受：“如果他们允准、不会令你受罚，你愿意援手，我当然感激不尽。待七年后重返地府，我一定替你多多上值。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The big yellow dog's mouth continued to move, conveying Yun Baili's voice: "General Mian, Yun also knows a few words. There is a word 'Fang' on the flower. I guess it was given to you by your adoptive mother, right? It's hard to get the two flowers back to honor Sister Meng. I took them down to exchange for the soul-renewing pill. After thinking about it, Yun thought it was too hot to hold, so I gave it to you."

"You are quite a nice person." Qin Mian took out the golden flower from the dog's mouth.

Naturally, it was wet and covered with yellow dog saliva.

Yun Baili was afraid that she would be disgusted and embarrassed to do anything, so he proactively suggested: "It's all this naughty dog's saliva, wipe it off quickly."

Qin Mian took out his handkerchief and wiped it, and asked, "How long will you stay in the world of the earth?"

"Today at Haishi, I have to go back to the underworld. I didn't say I was giving you something. What I told the city god was that I came to make another announcement to you. If Mo Menglang's actions change the fate of too many people due to the resurrection of the soul to investigate the case, I'm afraid that the empress Houtu will blame the underworld and no longer give us positions to work as ghosts."

After Qin Mian heard this, he let out a low "Huh".

Yun Baili heard her vague disappointment and pointed out: "Do you think that since I can inhabit the souls of cats and dogs, I can also possess the bodies of some servants and maids, go to the homes of those who plot against you, and learn about their words and deeds?"

Qin Mian nodded: "I did have thoughts when I saw you just now. But after listening to what you said, I think the Queen of Gods and Ghosts strictly prohibits you from intervening in the cause and effect of the human world. You can only reward good and punish evil after death. I have strict control over ghosts. I can't let you disobey the order. Just like the ghost who fell into Jin's shop, I have to pay attention to everything, and I can't bring trouble to the Jin family's young and old in order to find out the truth."

Yun Baili waggled his tail, stared at the mottled tree shadows on the sand, and listened quietly.

When Mrs. Meng invited him to drink, she often chatted with him. What women are best at is pretending to be considerate, pitiful, and helpless, and at the same time putting on a moral emphasis, with a false face of preferring others to betray me rather than me to betray others.

In this way, women can draw out men's heroic spirit of standing up and trick them into becoming pawns or even scapegoats.

Yun Baili could hear a few words of Meng Po's words, but for Qin Mian, even though he had not dealt with her for long, he still believed that this girl was not playing hard to get.

Qin Mian doesn't need to be reincarnated many times in the future. As long as he finds the truth and can give an explanation to his benefactor, how can he be a cunning, selfish and manipulative rat?

Yun Baili wanted to help her and tried his best to help her.

Even he and she are both ants.

Yun Baili squatted down like a dog, and said to Qin Mian in a tone that was half comforting and half inquiring: "How about you take this yellow dog back to the Golden Mansion to raise it after I leave my soul today? I will try to ask the City God or Lord Yan later. Even if the yellow dog can occasionally possess the soul, it may be able to help you."

Qin Mian did not accept it happily: "If they allow it and you will not be punished, and you are willing to help, I will certainly be grateful. When you return to the underworld in seven years, I will definitely do a lot for you."
